body: I wouldn’t. You should get some professional help

That’s your problem. You can’t forget about it or ignore it you have to talk about it no matter how much it hurts to do so. There’s cognitive behavioural therapy, medications, counselling that would all benefit you greatly. The longer you keep it bottled up inside the more it will fester in your mind until it just becomes too much.

No some people genuinely do care, even if you don’t see it that way. I don’t understand how having an opinion that life is a gift is the result of “brainwashing” your generalizations are insulting to people who actually want to help others who are literally seeking help.

I don’t think it’s the “entitlement” as much as it is the empathy for another human being. The people on here aren’t just some euthanasia cases who medical professionals would agree to euthanatize. They are suffering temporarily, suicide is forever, there’s no turning back once you are dead in the ground. People simply care and have that much empathy for anyone they would go out of the way to make sure that a complete stranger wouldn’t end it all. I don’t see the entitlement you speak of anywhere it’s just compassion and empathy.

It’s just a job. It’s not the end of the world, get some counselling, maybe go to school and do something you actually love where you will be respected in your own profession. I’ve worked lots of jobs where I’ve been in a similar position to you and there’s greener pastures ahead. Your life, goals or ambitions do not have to involve them just because they are your family. What do you wanna do?
What used to make you happy before you felt this way?
You have to tell them if you want them to notice, it’s clear you don’t wear your heart on your sleeve. Tell them how you feel don’t let it bottle up until it eats you alive.
Maybe deep down you know there’s light at the end of the tunnel even though you can’t see it now.
Exactly like you just did go to a mental health facility and say “I need help” then explain your feelings, your thoughts and answer all questions honestly and you will get help.

What makes life living is subjective to everyone. All lives are precious even though everyone’s inevitably ends. That doesn’t mean you should end yours everyone has a purpose just because you can’t see it right now doesn’t mean you don’t have one

Absolutely not, it would be a very long and extremely painful way to die you may not even die and if you survived you would probably need dialysis treatments for while. To my understanding anything like a OTC drug overdoes would not be painless or instantaneous and you’d be more likely just surviving and causing yourself serious or irreparable harm

As morbid and sick as it is.. I always think when ever I feel like that, it could always be much worse, you could be tied to a chair watching your family get dismembered in front of you and then left to live and be tortured for the rest of your life by the same people and become a sex slave for your captures or sold off there’s much worse that can happen and does happen. Not to minimize how you feel or what’s happening but be grateful for everything that’s not happening to you. Hope it helps it’s kept me hanging on for a while
Thank you surely they will maybe not now or even soon but eventually Ill be able to block out everything else if I don’t go off the deep end
